=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Night Watch."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Market: nobody stirred."
Isolde: "On the first night, I watched the Market: I saw Agnes out."
Isolde: "Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Agnes out."
Isolde: "It pains me to say this aloud, truly, yet I fear Agnes. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #66, #67, #68, #69, #70]
Agnes: "Oh, Last night, communing with the dead at Hollis's hearth, I learned nothing they hadn't already told us."
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Isolde. Isolde claims to have seen me out at night, which is a lie."
Agnes: "I did see Odette and Bartholomew out on the Market last night."  [case board: #71, #72, #73, #74]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Archivist."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Hollis and Agnes is the Revenant."  [case board: #75, #76]
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Odette. I saw them out on the Market last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #77]
Edda: "No sense keeping the lid on the pot when the kitchen's smoking. I am the Rumormonger."
Edda: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Merrin and Odette is Marked, and may read as evil."  [case board: #78, #79]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Martyr."
Nisha: "On the first night, I have given my life over for Hollis, should the town ever hang them."
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Isolde about Agnes."  [case board: #80, #81, #82]
